mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_post (blog_id, category_id, title, content, thumbnail_url, visibility, status, published_at) VALUES (#{blogId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{visibility}, #{status}, NOW() NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.blog_id, b.user_id AS author_user_id, b.blog_name, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.profile_image_url AS author_profile_image_url, p.title, p.content, p.thumbnail_url, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.visibility, p.status, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.published_at, p.created_at FROM blog_post p JOIN blog_blog b ON b.id = p.blog_id JOIN blog_user u ON u.id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.blog_id AS blogId, b.blog_name AS blogName, p.title, LEFT( REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE(p.content, '<[^>]+>', ''), '[#*`_~]', '' ), '[[:space:]]+', ' ' ), 150 ) AS summary, p.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, c.name AS categoryName, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, p.comment_count AS commentCount, p.published_at AS publishedAt FROM blog_post p JOIN blog_blog b ON b.id = p.blog_id LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON c.id = p.category_id
ORDER BY p.published_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, category_id = #{categoryId}, visibility = #{visibility}, status = #{status}, published_at = CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL AND #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN NOW() ELSE published_at END WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE blog_post SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE blog_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_post SET like_count = GREATEST(0, like_count + #{delta}) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_post SET comment_count = GREATEST(0, comment_count + #{delta}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.blog_id, b.blog_name, u.nickname AS author_nickname, p.title, p.visibility, p.status, p.created_at FROM blog_post p JOIN blog_blog b ON b.id = p.blog_id JOIN blog_user u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT b.user_id FROM blog_post p JOIN blog_blog b ON b.id = p.blog_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
